one_line: LLMs edit weights, Anthropic boosts compute spend, AI firms raise billions for expansion.

themes.title: Llm edits neural network weights
themes.text: MIT researchers demonstrated that a large language model (GPT‑6 Astra) can directly modify a small model’s weights, changing only 0.016% of parameters and raising math and reasoning scores. The same technique was shown to improve performance on MATH‑500 and GSM8K benchmarks.

stories.headline: MIT researchers show LLMs can read and edit neural network weights without retraining
GPT-6 Astra edits 0.016% of Qwen3.5-0.8B weights, boosting math performance sixfold

themes.title: Anthropic ramps up compute spending
themes.text: Anthropic disclosed $895.4 billion in compute‑related purchase commitments and a 1,100% year‑over‑year revenue increase, while also noting slower revenue growth and financing risks ahead of its upcoming IPO.

stories.headline: Anthropic reports $895.4 billion in compute‑related purchase commitments and leases
Anthropic reports 1,100% revenue surge ahead of IPO, commits $895B to compute
Anthropic revenue growth slows as compute financing risks rise ahead of IPO

themes.title: AI firms secure billions for growth
themes.text: Salesforce agreed to buy Cresta for $2.7 billion, Oracle launched a $20 billion stock‑and‑bond offering, Alphabet sold €6 billion of bonds, and OpenAI highlighted India as its largest ChatGPT market as it expands infrastructure. NVIDIA also began deploying AI services in cities worldwide.

stories.headline: Salesforce to acquire Cresta for $2.7 billion
Oracle to raise $20 billion via stock and bond sales for AI data centers
Alphabet launches €6 billion euro‑denominated bond sale, €17 billion demand
India becomes ChatGPT’s largest market by weekly active users, base doubles since Jan 2026
NVIDIA expands physical and agentic AI services to cities worldwide
